verdict.rationale: PostHog's docs and MCP documentation explicitly claim agents can run trends/funnels/retention/SQL queries and 'assemble dashboards, share them, and set alerts' via MCP or API (posthog-docs-2,3,19,24), and an OpenAPI spec exists for programmatic access. However, all supporting evidence is vendor-authored docs with no independent confirmation of full end-to-end dashboard creation, and one community report describes the AI/LLM features being unreliable and slow (posthog-comm-8), tempering confidence in real-world execution.
